description.value:
You conjure three bolts of ionic energy and hurl them at one target or split them among several within range. Make a separate ranged tech attack for each bolt; each one that hits deals 2d4 ion damage.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional bolt for each slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
